description: BTIDES LMP packet information data types

timing_control_flags.description: 1-byte value. bit0 = timing change, bit1 = use initialization 1/2, bit2 = no access window, bit3-7 = reserved.

sniff_subrating_instant.description: 4-byte value indicating bits 27:1 of the Central's Bluetooth clock value at the sniff subrating instant. Only even values are valid.

rcvd_opcode_str.description: Optional string version of the rcvd_opcode (e.g. like 'LMP\_ACCEPTED').

rcvd_opcode.description: One byte value indicating the opcode of the LMP command being accepted or not accepted.

rcvd_extended_opcode_str.description: Optional string version of the rcvd_extended_opcode (e.g. like 'LMP\_ACCEPTED\_EXT').

rcvd_extended_opcode.description: The opcode which was used for the extended LMP command that's being accepted or not accepted.

rcvd_escape_opcode.description: The 'escape' opcode (one of 124-127, per spec) which was used for the extended LMP command that's being accepted or not accepted.

poll_interval.description: 2-byte value indicating the poll interval in slots. Only even values are valid. Range 0x0006 to 0x1000. Spec default is 40.

paging_scheme_settings.description: 1-byte value indicating the paging scheme settings. For mandatory scheme: 0 = R0, 1 = R1, 2 = R2, 3-255 = reserved for future use.

paging_scheme.description: 1-byte value indicating the paging scheme. 0 = mandatory scheme, 1-255 = reserved for future use.

min_sniff_mode_timeout.description: 2-byte value indicating the minimum sniff mode timeout in slots. Only even values are valid.

max_sniff_subrate.description: 1-byte value indicating the maximum sniff sub-rate. Valid range: 1-255.

hold_time.description: 2-byte value indicating the hold time in slots. Only even values less than or equal to (supervisionTO * 0.999) are valid. Range is 0x0014 to 0x8000.

hold_instant.description: 4-byte value indicating bits 27:1 of the Central's Bluetooth clock value at the hold instant. Only even values are valid.

escape_127.description: The 'escape' opcode of 127 (0x7F) that's used at the offset that would normally be the LMP opcode. Used for extended LMP commands (suffixed with _EXT).

error_code_str.description: Optional string version of the error_code (e.g. like 'Synchronous Connection Limit To A Device Exceeded').

error_code.description: One byte value indicating the reason for rejection.

clk_adj_slots.description: 1-byte value indicating the difference between the clocks at the adjustment instant in slots (i.e. CLKnew[27:1] - CLKold[27:1]).

clk_adj_offset.description: 2-byte signed value indicating the offset between the old and new slot boundaries in microseconds. Valid range -624 to +624. (Previously named clk\_adj\_us in spec versions 5.2 and earlier.)

clk_adj_id.description: 1-byte value chosen by the Central as a handle to identify a Coarse Clock Adjustment event.

air_mode.description: 1-byte value indicating the air mode. 0 = mu-law log, 1 = A-law log, 2 = CVSD, 3 = transparent data, 4-255 = reserved for future use.

SAM_Index.description: 1-byte value indicating the SAM slot map index. Valid range 0-2 and 0xFF.

OOB_authentication_data.description: 1-byte value indicating OOB authentication data. 0 = No OOB Authentication Data received, 1 = OOB Authentication Data received, 2-255 = reserved for future use.

NBC.description: 1-byte value indicating the minimum number of times that an ASB broadcast packet should be sent.

IO_capabilities.description: 1-byte value indicating IO capabilities. 0 = Display only, 1 = Display YesNo, 2 = KeyboardOnly, 3 = NoInputNoOutput, 4-255 = reserved for future use.

Authentication_Requirements.description: 1-byte value indicating authentication requirements. 0x00 = MITM Protection Not Required - No Bonding, 0x01 = MITM Protection Required - No Bonding, 0x02 = MITM Protection Not Required - Dedicated Bonding, 0x03 = MITM Protection Required - Dedicated Bonding, 0x04 = MITM Protection Not Required - General Bonding, 0x05 = MITM Protection Required - General Bonding, 0x06-0xFF = reserved for future use.
